response.sql:
WITH linked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    sf.optvolrt,
    trd.tradekind
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader trd ON tr.trdref = trd.tradereg
),
pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    transref,
    tradekind,
    AVG(optvolrt) as pair_avg_optvolrt
  FROM linked_data
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) as overall_avg_optvolrt
  FROM linked_data
),
pair_with_deviations AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.transref,
    pa.tradekind,
    pa.pair_avg_optvolrt,
    pa.pair_avg_optvolrt - oa.overall_avg_optvolrt as deviation
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
type_avg_deviation AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(deviation) as type_avg_deviation
  FROM pair_with_deviations
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pwd.transref,
    pwd.tradekind,
    pwd.pair_avg_optvolrt,
    pwd.deviation,
    pwd.deviation - tad.type_avg_deviation as excess
  FROM pair_with_deviations pwd
  INNER JOIN type_avg_deviation tad ON pwd.tradekind = tad.tradekind
  WHERE pwd.deviation > tad.type_avg_deviation
)
SELECT 
  tradekind,
  AVG(pair_avg_optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt,
  AVG(deviation) as avg_deviation,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_pairs
GROUP BY tradekind
ORDER BY tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: "Deviation beats the type's average deviation" means the pair's deviation is numerically greater than the type's average deviation (deviation > type_avg_deviation), not a magnitude comparison. The request's phrase "note by how much" (excess = deviation - type_avg_deviation) supports this interpretation.

Pairs with multiple sentiment snapshots linked to the same (transref, tradekind) combination contribute all their optvolrt values to the pair average. Since each transaction has one trader with one trader type, (transref, tradekind) pairs are effectively transaction-level, but grouped as specified by the request.
"No rows if that's missing" refers to the overall average being NULL. If all optvolrt values are NULL or no sentiment snapshots link to transactions/traders, the query returns empty results.

alternatives.interpretation: "Beats" could mean the absolute magnitude of deviation exceeds the absolute magnitude of the type's average deviation, comparing |deviation| > |type_avg_deviation| rather than the signed comparison.
